verdict.rationale: Docs clearly describe natural-language generation of a full-stack app (frontend, backend, DB, auth) via chat, and community reports confirm it does produce working prototypes/MVPs quickly (e.g., PM prototyping, internal CRUD tools). However, multiple hands-on accounts cite code quality issues (single-file bloat, 'any' types), performance/architecture problems, security concerns for non-technical users, and high abandonment/churn once projects need to scale or productionize.
